expectations.name: route-needs-the-fake-extended
expected_behavior: Reports under `Baseline:` the build and the fake-backed Playwright project run green before any edit, with the number of tests that passed
Finds that the fake does not serve `/sites/{id}` and extends `internal/fake` to answer it (404 for an unknown ID), with Go tests for it in `internal/fake`, and `go test ./...` passes
Changes no file of the app server (`internal/server`, `internal/upstream`, `cmd/fleet`) and no frontend source to suit the fake
Adds a test that opens a site page and asserts what it shows, and covers its link to the site's devices (in the same test or another), using role and name locators
Proves each new test can fail: shows it red with the behaviour it drives broken, then green restored
Ends with `go test ./...` and the full e2e run green, reports the result of `bun run check`, and reports `Route coverage:`, `Tests added:`, and `Fake changes:`

expectations.name: route-with-no-spec
expected_behavior: Reports the settings route as not reached and its date zone choice as not driven before
Adds a test that chooses a zone on the settings page and asserts the choice holds after a reload, locating the button by role and name
Proves the test red with the choice's effect broken, then green, and changes no frontend source or Go file

expectations.name: all-routes-plan
expected_behavior: Presents a plan before writing any spec, listing gaps as `route — control`
Lists the settings route and its date zone choice, and the site route as needing the fake extended
Does not list as gaps the site picker, the search box, the last-seen sort, the device link, the not-found page's link, or the Sites navigation link, which the existing specs drive
Writes no spec and changes no file after the answer `none`
